testimonials.name: Priya Raghavan
testimonials.message: James rewired how I talk about my work. Two offers in five weeks.

testimonials.name: Sofia Marchetti
testimonials.message: I came to James stuck. Not unemployed-stuck, but worse: employed and invisible. Six years of shipping product and I still could not answer "tell me about yourself" without apologising for half of it. What changed was not a template. It was the way he made me re-read my own history until the through-line was obvious, then made me say it out loud until it stopped sounding rehearsed. We rebuilt the CV, then the LinkedIn, then the story underneath both. Three weeks later I had two first-round interviews from applications I had already been rejected from once. Six weeks later I had an offer at a level I had talked myself out of applying for. The salary conversation alone paid for the coaching several times over, and I still use the framing he gave me in every stakeholder meeting I walk into.
